title: My async PvP game
author: headWw
selftext:
\-TLDR at the bottom- \^\^

Hello everyone,

I'm a solo dev, been working as a Software Engineer for almost a decade(mostly OOP based languages, currently as a Full Stack Engineer guy for more than 5 years) and for the past few months, or maybe even a year if I take everything into consideration, I've been working on a game that took a lot of inspiration from a dead game that's almost 12+ years old now. The game that I've used to like/play a lot like 12+ years ago, it's called The Mighty Quest for Epic Loot(the PC game, not the mobile slop that came afterwards), most of you probably don't even know that game, but it stuck with me for a long time... unfortunately, Ubisoft screw that game up(like most of their games) and it never saw the light again...

The game that I'm working on, which is quite a bit different in a way, even the player base is different(focusing on mobile players first), but it has the same concept: Build and defend your castle with monsters/traps; Raid other players castles for gold/items/shards; Invest the drops gained to strengthen your defenses and to improve your hero. Pretty simple, it's a rinse and repeat loop and I'm taking a lot of inspiration from other popular games as well, like Clash of Clans for example, I love the idea in which you can take a 10 minute break from something(at work for example) clear your mind with a quick raid/get some loot, upgrade some stuff and continue with your day.

I have a pretty simple matchmaking which takes the ranking points named "Crowns" into separate groups and only displaying the castles that are in that player's crown range, it could display lower/higher castles in case the user reached like end game and has no castles in that range no more(will balance it a lot more when I do the testing phase), which speaking of testing, should be live in about a week or two at most.

I'm developing it in Unity + separate backend for server side stuff + anticheats(ASP.NET Core, psql 17, S3 storage, some custom VPS), most of the art is done with some custom local pipelines and running them on local llms(trellis, skintokens, ace-step for music and so on). I've been also using some KayKit art(amazing assets btw, I recommend them for chibi inspired games).

I'm still thinking about monetization, probably some rewarded adds at the end of a raid(when the player loots the vault chest) for one extra loot item, some skins, probably some QoL stuff like auto loot pet or something along the lines... and yeah, that's what I have at the moment.

I'm kind of new to the whole marketing stuff so I don't really have much else to brag about, it's something that I wanted to try for a long time and since opus 4.5 was released in November last year I started seriously spending time and increasing my knowledge around AIs for this purpose, my whole career happened because I wanted to be a game dev, but later I found out about how the industry sucks and everyone is being exploited till they collapse... So I moved away from it and switched to something else.



Probably missed a lot of other features/information about the game, mostly because I don't want to make it a wall of text which I probably already did, but I'm happy to respond to any questions you guys might have and also any ideas/tips are greatly appreciated as well :)



TLDR: Async PvP game on Unity, releasing on Android first, IOS probably after, trying to implement the whole Live Service idea by myself and hopefully making a fair and fun game



Sorry for any grammar mistakes.
